component: Shared mailnews obsolete registry IDL cleanup

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The eligible shared cleanup removes nsIMapiRegistry.idl from XPIDL_SOURCES and deletes the declaration. The named symbols have no remaining matches in the bounded Thunderbird/shared mail and mailnews search at the owned and fixed accepted endpoints. The accepted shared list still includes nsIMessengerOSIntegration. This is a declaration/build cleanup; it does not establish changed startup checking, prompt timing or native shell registration behavior. The unrelated Suite-only removed helper is excluded from support. No build or test ran.
title: The default-client cleanup removes the shared nsIMapiRegistry declaration
